Balloon.description: A balloon on a sheet that marks a characteristic (data model `Balloon`).

anchor.description: End of the leader line in sheet space, on the feature.

characteristic.description: The characteristic this balloon marks. The number shown is the characteristic number.

position.description: Center of the balloon in sheet space.

sheet.description: Sheet the balloon is drawn on.

style.description: Deviations from the project default style.

oneOf.description: Circle (D-24 default).
Flag: a rectangle with a pointed side.
Rectangle.

BalloonStyle.description:
How balloons are drawn (D-24). The project holds one default, balloons may override parts.

Sizes are millimeters on the sheet printed at its nominal paper size; multiply by
[`UNITS_PER_MM`] for sheet units. Because they live in sheet space they scale with the sheet.

leader.description: Whether a leader line is drawn from the balloon to its anchor.

size_mm.description: Diameter of a circle, height of a flag or rectangle, in mm.

BalloonStyleOverride.description: Per balloon deviations from the project default style. `null` means "use the default".

Characteristic.description:
One inspectable characteristic (data model 07, FR-CHR-01, FR-CHR-02).

Optional values are written as `null` in `project.json`, so every key is always present.

derivation.description:
Which rule produced the limits (FR-TOL-08). `null` if no rule was recorded, e.g. for a
characteristic without values.

inspect.description: False for reference and basic dimensions (D-25).

number.description:
Display number such as `12`, `12.1` or `12A`. Follows the placement order while
numbering is unlocked (D-21); kept when numbering is locked, where added characteristics
are numbered by the insert policy (D-23, FR-BAL-11).

origin.description: How the characteristic came into the project.

quantity.description: Number of features the characteristic stands for, from `4X` or `2 PL` (D-22). At least 1.

requirement_text.description: Text as it appears on the drawing.

sources.description: Regions of the drawing the characteristic was read from (FR-CHR-09).

unit.description: Unit of nominal, deviations and limits.

CharacteristicKind.description: What a characteristic describes (data model `Characteristic.kind`, FR-CHR-01).

oneOf.description: Linear size or distance.
Diameter (`Ø`, `⌀`, `DIA`).
Radius (`R`).
Spherical radius (`SR`).
Angle.
Chamfer, e.g. `1x45°`.
Thread, e.g. `M8x1.25-6H`.
Counterbore.
Countersink.
Depth of a hole or pocket.
Surface texture requirement.
Geometric tolerance (feature control frame).
Text note with an inspectable requirement.
Flag note, linked from a flag symbol.
Material or process requirement, e.g. hardness or coating.
Anything else. Default for a characteristic placed by hand before its kind is known.

CharacteristicStatus.description: Review state of a characteristic (data model `status`).

oneOf.description: Suggested by automation, not yet reviewed.
Accepted by the user. Characteristics placed by hand start here.
Checked by a second look.
Kept for traceability but not inspected.

Classification.description: Importance class of a characteristic (FR-CHR-02). Default `none` (D-26).

oneOf.description: Critical characteristic.
Major characteristic.
Minor characteristic.
Key characteristic.
Not classified.

CustomTable.description:
A custom tolerance table stored in the project container as `tolerances/<id>.toml`
(FR-TOL-07, M2 decision 4).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored file, checked when the project is opened.

table.description: Table id and version as in the file.

DecimalPlaceRule.description: Decimal place rule: a nominal written with `places` decimals gets `±tolerance` (FR-TOL-06).

places.description: Decimal places of the nominal, 0 to 10.

DerivationHint.description:
A remark on a derivation that the user should see, without changing the limits (spec 08
stage 7).

oneOf.description: The printed deviations differ from the fit table. The printed ones were kept.

table_lower_dev.description: Lower deviation of the fit table.

table_upper_dev.description: Upper deviation of the fit table.

oneOf.description: The fit is not in the fit table; no limits from it.
The size is outside the ranges of the table that would apply.
Reference dimension, not toleranced and not inspected by default (D-25, FR-CHR-08).
Basic (theoretically exact) dimension, not inspected by default (D-25, FR-CHR-08).

DerivationRule.description: The rule that produced the limits, with its parameters (FR-TOL-01 precedence, FR-TOL-08).

oneOf.description: Tolerance written on the callout: deviations, `±`, limits, `MIN` or `MAX`.
Fit designation expanded with a fit table (FR-TOL-04).

fit.description: The designation as written, e.g. `H7` or `H7/g6`.

range.description: Size step of the table the nominal lies in.

oneOf.description: Drawing specific rule, such as a custom table assigned to the project as drawing rule.
General tolerance standard by size range, e.g. ISO 2768-m (FR-TOL-02).
Decimal place rule, e.g. `X.XX ±0.05` (FR-TOL-06).

places.description: Decimal places of the nominal as written.

oneOf.description: General tolerance from a custom table of the user (FR-TOL-07).
No tolerance on the callout and no general rule: no limits, flagged for review.
Limits typed or edited by hand. Never re-interpreted automatically.

DisplayNumber.description: Display number: base, optional sub-number and letter suffix, e.g. "12", "12.1" or "12A".

DrawingRevision.description: One imported drawing file (data model `DrawingRevision`, FR-DOC-07).

file_name.description: File name at import, without directories.

label.description: Revision label from the title block or the user, e.g. `B`. Empty if unknown.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the imported file. The file is stored as `drawings/<sha256>.pdf`.

InsertPolicy.description:
Number given to a characteristic added while numbering is locked (FR-BAL-11, D-23).

Sub-numbers and letters follow the characteristic the new one is inserted after (the
anchor). Numbers given while locked are never given again, even after a delete, so an issued
number never changes meaning.

oneOf.description: One more than the highest base number ever given: after `12` comes `13` (default).
Next sub-number of the anchor's base number: after `12` comes `12.1`, then `12.2`.
Next letter of the anchor's number: after `12` comes `12A`, then `12B`.

Inspection.description: How a characteristic is inspected (FR-CHR-02). Empty text means not set.

sampling.description: Sampling plan, e.g. `100%` or `5 per lot`.

oneOf.description: The user locked it.
A report was exported as issued (D-23).

MultiInstance.description: How a callout for several features (`4X`, `2 PL`) is numbered (FR-BAL-07, D-22).

oneOf.description: One balloon with the quantity (default, D-22).
One number per feature as sub-numbers, `5.1`, `5.2`.

Numbering.description:
Numbering state of the project (D-21, D-23).

Unlocked: numbers always follow the placement order, `1..=n` with sub-numbers for
multi-instance groups when the project uses them (D-22), and every add, delete or move
renumbers. Locked: numbers never change, deletions leave gaps, moves are refused and added
characteristics are numbered by [`NumberingSettings::insert_when_locked`].

lock.description: The lock, if numbering is locked.

NumberingLock.description: State of a numbering lock (FR-BAL-10, D-23).

given.description:
Sub-numbered and lettered numbers present when locking (D-22) or given while locked,
including those of deleted characteristics, sorted (FR-BAL-11).

highest_number.description: Highest base number given so far, including numbers of deleted characteristics.

NumberingSettings.description: Numbering settings of a project (FR-BAL-04, FR-BAL-07, FR-BAL-11).

insert_when_locked.description: How characteristics added while numbering is locked are numbered (D-23).

NumberingStrategy.description:
Order in which characteristics are numbered (FR-BAL-04, D-21). The last strategy applied with
[`Command::ApplyNumbering`](crate::command::Command::ApplyNumbering); the rules are in
[`numbering`](crate::numbering).

oneOf.description:
Sheet, then zone, then reading order inside the zone (top to bottom, left to right).
Without a zone grid, reading order on the sheet. Default for new projects (D-21).
View by view, reading order inside each view.
View by view, clockwise around the view center starting at 12 o'clock.
Grouped by characteristic kind.
The current placement order; the user reorders by hand.

OrientedBox.description: Oriented bounding box in sheet space: center, size and rotation (data model `SourceRegion`).

angle.description:
Rotation in degrees, counterclockwise as seen on the sheet, in the range (-180, 180].
`0` is text read left to right, `90` is text read bottom to top.

size.description: Size of the box before rotation.

Origin.description: How a characteristic came into the project (data model `origin`).

oneOf.description: Placed by hand.
Read from a box the user drew (M2).
Accepted from automatic detection (M4).
Carried over from an earlier drawing revision (M6).

x.description: Distance from the left sheet edge in PDF user units.

y.description: Distance from the top sheet edge in PDF user units.

ProjectInfo.description: Descriptive data of the inspected part. Empty text means not set.

numbering.description: How characteristics are numbered (D-21, D-22, D-23).

tolerance.description: Tolerance rules of the project (M2 decision 2, FR-TOL-06, FR-TOL-09).

RangeBound.description: One end of a size range, as in the table row (exact decimals, rule 5).

inclusive.description: Whether the bound belongs to the range.

value.description: The bound in the table's size unit.

Rect.description: Axis aligned rectangle in sheet space, for example a drawing frame or a view (M2 decision 1).

Rotation.description:
Clockwise rotation used to view a sheet, in 90 degree steps (FR-DOC-05).

Only the view rotates. Stored geometry stays in unrotated sheet space (rule 4).

oneOf.description: Not rotated.
90 degrees clockwise.
180 degrees.
270 degrees clockwise (90 counterclockwise).

Scale.description: Drawing scale as printed in the title block, e.g. `1:2` (FR-DOC-05).

actual.description: Corresponding length on the part. At least 1.

drawing.description: Length on the drawing. At least 1.

Sheet.description: One sheet (PDF page) of a drawing revision.

index.description: Zero based page index in the PDF.

size.description: Size in PDF user units, unrotated.

unit.description:
Length unit of the dimensions on this sheet, `mm` or `in`. Default `mm` (D-20: never
inferred from the sheet size).

views.description: Views drawn by hand, in the order the user drew them (M2 decision 1).

zone_grid.description: Zone grid of the drawing frame, defined by hand in M2 (M2 decision 1, D-21).

SheetKind.description: How the text of a sheet is stored, which decides the recognition path (FR-DOC-03).

oneOf.description: PDF text objects cover the dimension text.
Text was exported as curves.
Scanned or image only.

SheetView.description: A view of the drawing, drawn by hand as a rectangle (M2 decision 1, FR-BAL-04 "per view").

label.description: Name as printed, e.g. `A-A` or `Detail B`. Empty if none.

rect.description: Rectangle around the view, in sheet space.

Size.description: A width and height in PDF user units.

height.description: Vertical extent; for an oriented box, along its own y axis before rotation.

width.description: Horizontal extent; for an oriented box, along its own x axis before rotation.

SizeRange.description: The size range of the table row a value came from, e.g. "over 30 up to and including 120".

max.description: Upper bound; `null` means the range is open ended.

min.description: Lower bound; `null` means the range starts above zero.

SourceRegion.description: The region of a sheet a characteristic was read from (FR-CHR-09).

raw_text.description: Raw recognized text, if any text was read.

TableClass.description: A range table and its class column, e.g. ISO 2768-1 class `m` (FR-TOL-02, M2 decision 2).

TableLookup.description: A value read from a range table: which table, part, column and row (FR-TOL-02, FR-TOL-07).

part.description: Part id in the table, e.g. `linear`, `radius_chamfer` or `angular`.

range.description: Range of the row that covers the size.

TableRef.description:
A tolerance table by id and version (`data/tolerances/`, D-43). Shipped tables are referenced
this way; custom tables are also copied into the project (M2 decision 4).

TextSource.description: Where the text of a source region came from (data model `SourceRegion`).

oneOf.description: Region drawn by the user; no text was read.
Text objects of the PDF.
Optical character recognition.

ToleranceDerivation.description:
Which rule produced the limits of a characteristic and what the user should know about it
(data model `ToleranceDerivation`, FR-TOL-08). No free text: explanations are rendered from
this (M2 decision 3).

draft.description: True if a value came from a table with `status = "draft"`; the UI shows a badge (D-43).

ToleranceSettings.description:
Tolerance settings of a project (M2 decision 2, FR-TOL-01, FR-TOL-06, FR-TOL-09).

New projects have no general tolerance, so untoleranced dimensions get "no tolerance
defined" until the user sets one.

custom_tables.description: Custom tables stored in the project, sorted by id, ids unique (M2 decision 4).

decimal_rules.description: Decimal place rules, sorted by places, at most one per number of places (FR-TOL-06).

drawing_rule.description:
Custom table of the project that applies as drawing specific rule, above the general
tolerance (FR-TOL-01 level 3).

Unit.description: Unit of a nominal value and its limits.

oneOf.description: Millimeter.
Inch.
Degree of angle (decimal degrees).

UnitConversion.description: A unit conversion applied to nominal and limits (FR-TOL-09).

places.description: Decimal places the converted values were rounded to.

UnitRounding.description: Rounding of values converted between mm and inch (FR-TOL-09).

inch_places.description: Decimal places of values converted to inch, 0 to 10.

mm_places.description: Decimal places of values converted to mm, 0 to 10.

ZoneGrid.description:
The zone grid of a drawing frame: equal columns and rows inside the frame rectangle, with
the labels printed on the frame (D-21 "sheet, then zone").

Labels are listed left to right and top to bottom as they appear on the sheet, so grids
numbered from the right or lettered from the bottom are stored as printed.

column_labels.description: Column labels, left to right, e.g. `1` to `8`. One per column, at least one.

frame.description: Inner frame rectangle the zones divide, in sheet space.

row_labels.description: Row labels, top to bottom, e.g. `A` to `F`. One per row, at least one.

description:
A Dimo project (data model `Project`).

Change it only through [`Document::execute`](crate::document::Document::execute), so every
change is undoable and audited (ADR 0001, NFR-REL-02).

revisions.description: Imported drawing files, oldest first. Old revisions stay for traceability.
